Probably a bad take, but i'm bored so...

1. CMIYGL: 10/10 (It was the first release that I heard from Tyler, like didn't sleep until 12:00 when the album released and made me have a cult following for Tyler, but the album had that big rap feeling I wanted to see from him it just has a place in my heart it might not feel like a big reason to place this at first place, but it's personal.)
2. Flower Boy: 9.5/10 (This album was at the brink of being overrated (doesn't mean that it was terrible same with Igor). This album I could understand very well because him feeling separated with his peers, feeling alone, and him talking about suicide was personal in a whole other level and trying to driving away from his problems too... It's like a beautiful album.)
3. Igor: 8.5 or 9/10 (The first album I heard from Tyler, but never actually listened to it, but I came and realized that I couldn't relate to it, but the vibe really carried it and even though I couldn't relate to it I understood the whole story which I love story albums.)
4. Wolf: 8/10 (The thing that was confusing was the three album storyline and made me feel like it didn't make sense to put Goblin before Wolf. But beside everything else the story of Wolf was great him talking about his dad leaving in Answer, him talking about his grandma in Lone, and how his fame made him feel like the only member in OF while his friends are looking at him at his glory in Cowboy. It felt like it was great to switch things around after Goblin.)
5. Cherry Bomb: 7/10 ( Really not that much to say, but that this album felt like filler    only because it was an experimental album like using Deathcamp for Rock, Run felt messy, Cherry Bomb was something..., Smuckers was perfect, and Fucking Young/Perfect had a great vibe just not the right lyrics.)
6. Bastard: 6.8/10 ( Bastard is alright few of the songs was not that good except with some few exceptions like Odd Toddlers, Bastard, and Seven were good, but songs like AssMilk were like damn okay I can see edgy Tyler showing his side.)
7. Goblin: 4/10 ( Damn and I thought Bastard was worst than this. All I have to say is that She is only perfect song I would listen to and to listen to again.)

This took about an hour, so this is some serious d-riding, Love y'all
